scripts.cdk:trigger-dev: aws lambda invoke --function-name $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name PNMACComputeStack-dev --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='IngestLambdaName'].OutputValue" --output text) --invocation-type Event --payload '{}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out response.json
scripts.cdk:trigger-prod: aws lambda invoke --function-name $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name PNMACComputeStack-prod --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='IngestLambdaName'].OutputValue" --output text) --invocation-type Event --payload '{}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out response.json
